an6.18:1.1: 18 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ.
an6.18:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā addhānamaggaṃ paṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vikkiṇamānaṃ
an6.18:1.3: disvā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi
an6.18:1.5: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave asuṃ macchikaṃ macchabandhaṃ macche vadhitvā vikkiṇmānanti
an6.18:2.2: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā
an6.18:2.3: macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasantoti
an6.18:2.6: mayāpi kho etaṃ bhikkhave neva diṭṭhaṃ na sutaṃ
an6.18:2.7: macchiko macchabandho macche vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhoga bhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasantoti
an6.18:2.9: te hi so bhikkhave macche vajjhe vadhāyānīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati
an6.18:3.2: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā

an6.18:3.9: te hi so bhikkhave gāvo vajjhe vadhāyānīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati
an6.18:4.2: apinu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā
an6.18:4.6: māgaviko mige vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasantoti

an6.18:4.10: māgaviko mige vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasantoti
an6.18:4.12: te hi so bhikkhave mige vajjhe vadhāyānīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati
an6.18:4.13: te hi so bhikkhave tiracchānagate pāṇe vajjhe vadhāyānīte pāpakena manasānupekkhati tasmā so neva hatthiyāyī hoti na assayāyī na rathayāyī na yānayāyī na bhogabhogī na mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasati
an6.18:4.14: ko pana vādo yaṃ manussabhūtaṃ vajjhaṃ vadhāyānītaṃ pāpakena manasānupekkhati
an6.18:4.15: taṃ hi tassa bhikkhave hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya
an6.18:4.16: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatīti.
